scientific_integrity: Proof is a general structural enumeration. Independent direct brute force is finite corroboration only. The publication-priority comparison identifies potential unindexed clique-gluing results as a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact palette equals the blade-clique size, all blades have the same size, and at least two blades share one hub. Larger palettes, nonclique blocks, and unrelated forcing notions are outside the theorem. Independent review has not been performed.
title: Exact forcing-colouring spectrum of clique windmills
